name: Ironlatch
description: Inhabits the door lock of a specific Shelf apartment building and has developed a preference for which residents it lets in quickly and which ones it makes wait.
observed_behavior: Opens doors fractionally faster for residents it has categorized as 'belonging.' Adds subtle delays for strangers. Has never locked anyone out — but the delays are noticeable.
story_hooks: New residents notice the door treats them differently and ask neighbors about 'the building's elf'
Ironlatch locks the door against someone for the first time — and the residents have to decide whether to trust it
